prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a skeletal knight in spiked mid-grey steel plate armour with dark outlines, a horned open-faced helm with a big bone-white grinning skull face filling the opening, clearly visible and bright against the armour, with two bright red eye lights, a short tattered dark red cloak hanging close behind the shoulders, holding one black sword with glowing red runes on the blade; in the idle cell the sword is held point down in front of the body; centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides, the helm horns well below the top of the grey box. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: a grinning skull with two red eye lights inside the horned helm.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, stepping forward toward the heroes at the end of a downward cut, the black sword angled down in front of him with the point at knee height just ahead of his front foot, the whole sword well inside the middle cell (not raised overhead, not reaching the cell edge), facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the head thrown back with the horned helm still on the skull exactly as in the idle cell, the sword held upright across the chest, the cloak close behind, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight onto one leg and lean the torso toward the heroes, the elbows bent, so the sword stays well inside its own cell. The tattered cloak hangs close behind the body in every cell (never flying out). Draw only the parts named in the description, the same in every cell: no second cape, and no slash trail, smear or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a shield, flesh, a closed visor, gold armour, a long flowing cape, a scythe, a second sword, wings, a shadowed face, a bare skull without the helm.
